lines.speaker: helm
lines.text: Subordinate,

lines.speaker: helm
lines.text: my body has been feeling strange lately.

lines.speaker: helm
lines.text: Is there any way I can get to the bottom of this?
How exactly does your body feel strange?

lines.speaker: helm
lines.text: It's hard to explain,

lines.speaker: helm
lines.text: but everything just feels different ever since I came back from the hot spring,

lines.speaker: helm
lines.text: and I have no idea why.

lines.speaker: helm
lines.text: This has never happened before.
Could you give me a few more details?

lines.speaker: helm
lines.text: Hmm...

lines.speaker: helm
lines.text: First, my joint mobility has increased.

lines.speaker: helm
lines.text: Also, my skin used to be a walking disaster since all our training maneuvers were done in seawater,

lines.speaker: helm
lines.text: but now my skin has become as smooth as a baby's bottom,

lines.speaker: helm
lines.text: and the bruises on my body

lines.speaker: helm
lines.text: have all disappeared as well,

lines.speaker: helm
lines.text: along with all aches and pains.
Hmm...

lines.speaker: helm
lines.text: What could be the reason for all of this?

lines.speaker: helm
lines.text: The results from my latest maintenance report

lines.speaker: helm
lines.text: indicated no abnormalities.
I think you can chalk this all up to the hot spring.

lines.speaker: helm
lines.text: You mean the hot spring is responsible for all this?
Your muscles that were once tensed up are now relaxed, and your skin has improved.

lines.speaker: helm
lines.text: Ah,

lines.speaker: helm
lines.text: I get it now.

lines.speaker: helm
lines.text: The hot springs have a positive effect on the body.
And they seem to be pretty effective at that. I should pay a visit soon.

lines.speaker: helm
lines.text: Subordinate,

lines.speaker: helm
lines.text: how about we go together?

lines.speaker: helm
lines.text: I want to learn more about the effects they have.
Sure thing.
